admission: fail closed on early wake, expired budget or error; never retry or replace failed session
cadence: retain all rounds; report consecutive header-admission intervals; 3 requests require >=1050 ms steady cadence locally
cohort_freeze: after complete history merge, tail catch-up and protocol authentication
latency: primary: before admission of header through canonical verification; secondary: RPC start through verification
observation_scope: three retained current hash-pinned observations; coverage study, not repeated transport benchmark
overflow: stop without trimming; preserve validated prefix; do not freeze partial target
pacing: global local dispatch-start spacing; no burst credit; survives rotation; all waits count in run deadline
phase_budget: one global 512-method/900-second/350-ms gate; no reset between phases
rate_limit_claim: conservative local policy, not SLA or proof of provider arrival-window quota
reorg: invalidate registry on checkpoint mismatch; no automatic rollback or replacement
repeated_heads: retain and flag; reject regressions or a different hash at equal height
selection: all distinct Borrow onBehalf in a fixed contiguous window; retain accounts across future runs; no ranking by health or liquidation outcomes
transport: one persistent session for history, merge verification, tail, authentication and observation; no rotation
